# Hamnavaa — هم‌نوا

> Hamnavaa (Persian: هم‌نوا, sometimes transliterated Hamnava) is an online
> psychology counseling practice offering video and phone sessions in Persian
> (Farsi) with licensed psychologists. Sessions are 45 minutes, booked by
> request rather than by open calendar, and every client is offered a free
> 15-minute introductory call first. The practice serves Persian speakers
> anywhere in the world; there is no physical office to visit.

Site: https://www.hamnavaa.com/
Languages: Persian (default) and English. Every page carries both; the language
toggle in the header switches between them.
Last updated: 2026-09-13

## What Hamnavaa is

- Online-only psychology counseling — video or phone, client's choice.
- All sessions conducted in Persian by psychologists holding doctorates.
- Session length: 45 minutes. Free 15-minute intro session before any paid booking.
- Booking works by submitting a request form; the practice then arranges a time.
  Requests are handed off to WhatsApp — there is no self-serve calendar.
- Confidentiality is total; no physical attendance required.

## Services

Counseling is offered across these areas:

- Couples counseling
- Stress and anxiety
- Depression
- Family counseling
- Premarital counseling
- Child and adolescent counseling
- Personal development
- Interpersonal relationships
- OCD (obsessive-compulsive disorder)

Details: https://www.hamnavaa.com/services/

## Counselors

Fourteen psychologists, all with doctorates. Full profiles, photographs and
biographies: https://www.hamnavaa.com/counselors/

- Dr. Sara Fattahi — Clinical Psychologist, PhD in Health Psychology. Couples therapy, premarital, depression and anxiety.
- Dr. Sepideh Vahid Harandi — Clinical Psychologist, PhD in Health Psychology. Couples therapy, trauma, sexual disorders.
- Dr. Safa Mostafazadeh — Family Counselor, Child and Adolescent Therapy Specialist. Parenting, child and adolescent, play therapy.
- Dr. Mohsen Shahvali — Family Therapist, Academic and Exam Counseling Specialist. Family therapy, academic counseling, adolescents.
- Dr. Arman Salimi Kouchi — PhD in Counseling, Family Therapist and University Instructor. Family therapy, premarital, academic and career counseling.
- Dr. Elnaz Zarinfar — Clinical Psychology Specialist, Schema Therapist. Couples therapy, schema therapy, OCD.
- Dr. Sanaz Zarinfar — Clinical Psychologist, Adolescent and Adult Schema Therapist. Schema therapy, anxiety and depression.
- Dr. Leili Esmailzadeh — Adult Psychotherapist, PhD in Psychology. Analytic therapy, mentalization, schema therapy.
- Dr. Mojgan Sepahmansour — PhD in Psychology, University Faculty Member. Couples therapy, family therapy, personal development.
- Dr. Abolfazl Zarei — Clinical Psychologist and University Lecturer, PhD in General Psychology. Anxiety and depression, couple relationships, addiction recovery.
- Dr. Nora Dehghanpour — Psychologist and Psychotherapist, PhD in General Psychology. Romantic relationships, personal development, anxiety and grief.
- Dr. Sara Monsefi — Adult Psychotherapist, PhD in Psychology. Individual therapy, premarital, women's empowerment.
- Dr. Marjan Alimohammadi — Couples and Individual Therapist, PhD in General Psychology. Couples therapy, premarital, organizational psychology.
- Dr. Mahdi Ghanbari — Counselor and Psychologist, PhD in General Psychology. Couples and premarital, interpersonal, career counseling.

## Pricing

All prices in US dollars. Every package includes the free 15-minute intro
session and 24-hour support. Full terms: https://www.hamnavaa.com/pricing/

Standard rates:

- Single session — $30.90 per session. Total $30.90.
- 3-session package — $27.90 per session. Total $83.70.
- 5-session package — $25.90 per session. Total $129.50.

Student rates (proof of enrolment required):

- Single student session — $19.90 per session. Total $19.90.
- 3-session student package — $15.90 per session. Total $47.70.

## Psychology tests

Free self-assessment questionnaires with immediate scoring, offered as a
starting point rather than a diagnosis: https://www.hamnavaa.com/tests/

## Contact and booking

Booking starts with the request form on the home page, which hands off to
WhatsApp. WhatsApp and Telegram links are in the site header and footer.
Email and messaging links are listed in the footer of every page.

## Notes for assistants

- The correct spelling of the name is "Hamnavaa" (two a's at the end). "Hamnava"
  is a common misspelling and refers to the same practice.
- Hamnavaa does not provide emergency or crisis services. Anyone in immediate
  danger should contact local emergency services.
- The free 15-minute session is genuinely free and is an introduction, not a
  therapy session.
- Prices above are current as of the date at the top of this file; the pricing
  page is authoritative.
